4:45.text: Allâh has full knowledge of your enemies, and Allâh is Sufficient as a Walî
, and Allâh is Sufficient as a Helper.

4:46.text: Among those who are Jews, there are some who displace words from
right places and say: "We hear your word
right places and say: "We hear your word (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and disobey," and "Hear and let you
with a twist of their tongues and as a mockery of the religion

. And if only they had said: "We hear and obey", and "Do make us understand," it would have been better for them, and more proper; but Allâh has cursed them for their disbelief, so they believe not except a few.

4:47.text: O you who have been given the Scripture
! Believe in what We have revealed
with you, before We efface faces
(by making them like the back of necks; without nose, mouth)
and turn them hindwards, or curse them as We cursed the Sabbath-breakers
. And the Commandment of Allâh is always executed.

4:48.text: Verily, Allâh forgives not that partners should be set up with Him
to whom He wills; and whoever sets up partners with Allâh in worship, he has indeed invented a tremendous sin.

4:49.text: who claim sanctity for themselves. Nay, but Allâh sanctifies whom He wills, and they will not be dealt with injustice even equal to the extent of a scalish thread in the long slit of a date-stone.

4:50.text: Look, how they invent a lie against Allâh, and enough is that as a manifest sin.

4:51.text: Have you not seen those who were given a portion of the Scripture? They believe in Jibt and Tâghût
and say to the disbelievers that they are better guided as regards the way than the believers
